name: British Columbia

standard.note: B.C.'s everyday plate is white with blue characters, a setting-sun flag emblem in the middle and the slogan "Beautiful British Columbia" along the bottom.

plates.title: BC Parks licence plate - Porteau Cove
plates.fact: The Park Enhancement Fund gets over 28% of each new BC Parks plate sale and 99% of every renewal.

plates.title: BC Parks licence plate - Purcell Mountains
plates.fact: Each BC Parks plate depicts a scene from one of B.C.'s parks and protected areas.

plates.title: BC Parks licence plate - Kermode Bear
plates.fact: The Kermode, or spirit bear, is a rare white-coated black bear found on B.C.'s north coast.

plates.title: Veteran licence plates
plates.fact: Eligible applicants include Canadian Armed Forces members and honourably discharged veterans, plus some allied veterans.

plates.title: Memorial Cross licence plates
plates.fact: These plates honour Memorial Cross recipients, the families of Canadian Forces members who died in service.

plates.title: Ham radio licence plates
plates.fact: Ham plates carry the owner's radio call sign so certified operators can be identified when helping with emergency communications.

notes: All images are ICBC's own small artwork (230x114 for Parks, ~175x88 for others); ICBC images on images.ctfassets.net load without cookies (verified in browser; the cloud sandbox proxy blocks ctfassets so it could not be curl-tested here). Standard image is ICBC's personalized-plate sample (same base design, custom text) since ICBC shows no plain standard plate. ICBC page says 40+ plate types, but the rest are commercial, farm, collector/vintage, prorate etc. (excluded). Ham radio included as hobby; drop it if call-sign plates count as vanity. Years left null (not stated on ICBC pages). WebFetch of icbc.com was blocked by provenance rules; browser used instead.
